parameters.question: Compare the Jackdaw (JD) chi-square uniformity test results for age-related CpG site density across chromosomes. The chi-square statistic must match the reference within 1% relative error, and degrees of freedom must match exactly. A p-value of 0 is fine when the true value is below floating-point precision. Column order and extra columns may differ.

Compare chi-square uniformity test results for CpG site density across Zebra Finch chromosomes. The chi-square statistic must match the reference within 1% relative absolute error, and degrees of freedom must match exactly. A p-value of 0 is acceptable when the true value is below floating-point precision. Column order and extra columns may differ.
